strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Pull Google wipe:

• Clear Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ Tu ka aves avri dino katar Google kontura (trebul te thoves len pale). bi te astarel pes.
• O aparato ćhivel pes pale automatikane palal.

San sigurno?
strings.logGwipeHead: 💣 O pherdo Google astarda te thovel pes — te thovel pes o magazino + servisura, palal kodoja te kerel pes o restarto...

strings.maintHint: Thov varesavo butòn te sikaves lesqi sasti deskripcia.
strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: dikhel o akanutno keybox mamuj e Google-esqi lista e revokaciaqi (CRL) thaj zumavel but źanglimata źi kana arakhel jekh validno keybox, jekh automatikano backup thaj jekh restarto e Google servisurenqo. Kerel buti pe sako ćàso thaj trubul les interneto (1-3 minutură).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox katar o netvorko: lel tele jekh keybox katar o oficijalno repozitoriumo (GitHub) thaj garavel les ko /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Trubul interneto thaj lel 1-3 minutia. Kerdo kana o smart fetch na kerel buti vaj kana o keybox sas paruvdo manualno.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnoza: dikhel e disponibilno Remote Key Provisioning modulura, dikhel e TEE verzia e certifikatosqi e atestaciaqi, thaj sikavel o stàto e KmInstallKeybox-esqo. Na paruvel khanci — jekh śukar dikhipen e statusosqo e aparatosqo.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kontrola (numaj te ginavel pes): sikavel Widevine niveloske indikatora (L1/L3) katar dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file prezenca, thaj relacia e sistemosqe proporcienqe. Na paruvel khanci.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manualo RKP laćharipe: kerel sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manualo. Laćharel e problemură e atestaciaqe kana o automatikano nakhavipen naśti te kerel pes. Sako drom sikavel jekh klaro sukseso/naśavipen.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Sasto RKP laćharipe: kerel sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh pherdo. Kerel buti e phare kazurenca thaj lel maj but vrama. Jekh klaro rezultato sikavel pes ko agor.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: ćhivel Play Store thaj Google servisura (GMS+GSF) data thaj ćhivel o aparato pale automatikane. Numaj vaś o śukar atestàcia — vov nisar na astarel tumare fotòra vaj tumare lilǎ.
strings.mdCertify: • Khelimasko certifikàcia: dikhel o RKP certifikàto atestàciaqo stàto e aparaturǎqo thaj resetisarel e atestàciaqe proporcie kana si trubujipe. Na astarel e date e uźitorenqe.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER laćharipen: laćharel Google problemură le śerutnimatenqe (SOTER) save si len relacia e atestaciaça le aparaturenqi. Kodo si kerdo vash nesave aparatura save dependin pe SOTER na pe Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Thov PIF: kerel sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh zor. Kerel o alosardo fingerprint (lokalno/avansime) thaj kerel o nevipe e pif.prop/pif.json lilengo. Jekh klaro rezultato sikavel pes ando lil.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF kontrola: sikavel o instalirimo motoro, e fingerprintoske dokumentura (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), thaj e registrura. Numaj te dikhes — na paruvel khanci.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: kerel sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Te lel o maj paluno Canary Engine avridipen te siguril pes i kompatibilitèta e obligatorikane RKP certifikàturenqe (februari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Diagnoza e motoresqi: dikhel o TrickyStoreOSS stàto (pid, logs), e lilǎ e śerutneske (aktivo vs o uźitori), o ćaćutno vs o ćorripen e aparaturǎqo, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP śerutne. Numaj diagnostikano sikavipe.
strings.hintKbSlots: O modulo kerel buti e duje thana e tastaturenqe: o angluno (sakralno, nisar na xasardo) thaj o dujto (backup). Kado tab sikavel savo sloto si aktivo, paruvel e preferenca, vaj promoviril o sekundarno ko primarno pe eksplicitno mangipe — e backup-encar thaj jekh pherdo lil.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integritetosko diagnoza: dikhel o TEE importo e chavesqo, i injekcia e bibliotekaqi and-o keystore2, o statuso e revokaciaqo (CRL), o śerutno lil e protekciaqo thaj o RKP stàto. Numaj te ginavel pes — na paruvel khanci.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Sigurno re-aplikàcia:

• I lista e protekciaqi si kerdini pale katar svako instalirime app.
• O strato e kompatibilitètosqo e custom-ROM-esqo si pale-aplikisardo.
• O aktivo keybox si pale-aplikisardo.
#001#•000 #service si restarted.

Khanchi na si xasardo thaj o angluno tastatura nisar na si astardo.

Maj dur?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: sikavel o than e primarno thaj sekundarno slotosko thaj paruvel e preferenca maškar lende. O primarno (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) si sajekh protektuime thaj nisar na xasarel pes. Te vazdel pes o sekundarno karing o primaro trubul eksplicitno konfirmacia.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promovisaren o sekundarno sloto ko primarno:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml avela o primarno slotosko sasto.
• O akanutno primaro si garavdo sar backup anglal o paruvipe.
• Khanchi na si xasardo — i operacia si reverzibilno.
000#Conue
?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Te ćhivel pes o dujto than:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ka avel ćhudino.
• O angluno than na si astardo.

Te źas maj dur?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (nevo and-o v3.17):

• Kontrolisarel o akanutno keybox mamuj i Google revokaciaqi lista (CRL).
• Zumavel but źanglimata źi kana arakhel pes jekh śukar keybox.
• Automatikano backup + restarts #000## servisura.

⚠️ Trubul interneto (1-3 min). Kerel maj dur?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Te lel pes o keybox katar o interneto:

• Te lel pes o oficialo keybox thaj te validisarel pes.
• Instalirime permanentno (nisar na irisajlo kana putarel pes).

⚠️ Trubul interneto (dži ko 1 min). Kerel maj dur?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Na si xasarde data vaj keybox files.
• Restartuin o telefono palal.

Te źas maj dur?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Sasto laćharipen:

• Re-provizie RKP + restart Google servisura.
• O aparato restartuil pes automatikane (niso na si ćhivdo).

Te źas maj dur?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart numaj.
• Khanchi na si xasardo thaj tu na ka aves avri ćhindo.
• O aparato restartuil pes automatikane.
000#000#Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Forcisar re-provizia (Red Magic):

• Vaś e aparaturǎ save ignorin o ćàso savo ćhudǎs pes.
• Kerel buti vi kana e ćàsura si saste.
• Na si xasarde data.

Te źas maj dur?
strings.confirmCertify:
Forcisar Play Store certifikàcia:

• Ćhivel numaj o Store cache — tiro konto si bi-astardo.
• Reboot, palal kodoja putar o Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Restartuil o vendor.soter serviso.
• Xramosarel numaj e SOTER serveroske date.

Te źas maj dur?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Thov o fingerprint (PIF):

• Konvertisarel custom.pif.prop thaj instalil les ko drom e motoresko.
• Trubul te kerel pes jekh nevo starto palal.

Te źas maj dur?
strings.confirmCanary:
Keren o nevo Canary fingerprint:

• Te lel pes o maj paluno oficijalno Canary fingerprint katar o Google.
• Sinhronizil o siguripasko patch + restartuil Google servisura (bi te thovel pes).

⚠️ Trubul interneto (1-3 min). Kerel maj dur?
